mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user (user_id, username, password, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{password}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_user SET user_id = #{userId}, username = #{username}, password = #{password}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, username, password, status, create_time, update_time FROM admin_user WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, user_id, username, password, status, create_time, update_time FROM admin_user WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY id
